subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-08-31
html:

/connect/search-console-mcpRetargeted the page's H1, <title>, meta description, TL;DR, section heading, and one FAQ from "Search Console MCP" to "Google Search Console MCP" — a live SE Ranking pull this session showed that exact phrase climbed from 0 to 390 searches/mo over the last 4 months (KD 16, near-zero competition), while the page was still only targeting the plain "Search Console MCP" phrasing, which gets just 50/mo. No new page, no URL change — pure on-page upside capture on an already-indexed page.google search console mcpaskarlo.app/connect/search-console-mcp

Why this instead of another blog post or new connector page: the connector matrix (5/5 live Google sources) and comparison hub (5/5 named competitors) are both still fully caught up, and catalog.ts is unchanged again — mailchimp's Aug 2026 ETA is now the current month with no slack left and still unshipped, meta_ads/hubspot/mailerlite/shopify/stripe all still overdue. Rather than force an 11th blog post, re-pulled live SE Ranking data across the MCP-integration and comparison keyword cluster to check for drift since the original July audit. Found one real, verified opportunity — this retarget — and ruled out two false leads: "agencyanalytics alternative" (480/mo, KD 9) turned out to already be the lead phrase in that comparison page's meta title, and "meta ads mcp" (590/mo, real and rising) can't get a page yet because Meta Ads is still coming_soon in catalog.ts — building one now would advertise a connector that doesn't exist.

Needs your attention (unchanged): mailchimp's catalog.ts ETA ("August 2026") is now due with the month closing — worth confirming ship status; if it flips to live, that's the first new connector-matrix page available in 5+ months. Off-page link building is still 0 of 6 directories/registries (needs a human with a browser). GSC submission and the dormant 6-persona route.ts scaffold decision are both still open from prior sessions.

Next: a weekly-pulse-style session (backlinks, CI status, catalog.ts re-check, full rank-position report) is due around 2026-09-04. Full detail in docs/seo-strategy/worklog.txt (top entry).
